scope: Read-only source structure and data-lifetime audit; functional simulation and netlist audit are separate evidence.

lifetime_review: XMSS compound 0 writes temporary_key, 1 writes mask0, 2 writes mask1 only for binary hashes; final uses all required values before compound reset.
Unary MASKED_VALUE never reads mask1; binary retains request_right through all key/mask subhashes.
chain_value survives intermediate key/mask hashes and changes only at the final hash for each chain step.
captured_value is written on the final-round edge selected by capture index; intermediate key/mask hashes suppress capture.
Compact SLH seed/chain feedback reads advanced_state directly, preserving first hash counter and requested capture position.
Inputs and shared coordinates must remain stable until response consumption as documented by the module contract.
